mapper.select: SELECT attendance_id as attendanceId, employee_id as employeeId, work_date as workDate, check_in_time as checkInTime, check_out_time as checkOutTime, status as status, tardy_reason as tardyReason, modify_reason as modifyReason FROM attendance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND work_date = #{workDate}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) as normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'TARDY' THEN 1 END) as tardyCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'EARLY_LEAVE' THEN 1 END) as earlyLeaveCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 END) as absentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'VACATION' THEN 1 END) as vacationCount FROM attendance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND DATE_FORMAT(work_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth}
